properties.name: Mogyoróska

constructionEvidence.name: Mogyoróska
constructionEvidence.note: Very coarse whole named hillside tract between the actual Templom/Temető approach, Hangulat/Körte hillside lanes, Panoráma-side woodland track and Vízipark/Ipar access system. A historical Mogyoród town map names Mogyoróska near Ipar utca, and municipal archaeology independently attests the Mogyoróska geographical name (site 26185, parcels 0242/23 and 0242/1). This outline is an inference of the enclosing physical hillside road/field block; it is NOT a reproduction of that archaeological site, which the municipal report itself says had an inaccurate old boundary. Postal data categorizes the place as institutional/sport, but equivalence to a particular modern attraction is unproven. The broad geographic tract is preserved at very low confidence instead of an arbitrary facility footprint or point box.
